LightningComponentBundle.description: Configurable AI panel that runs Salesforce Prompt Templates via Invocable Actions. Drop on any page, the SE picks which prompts to expose. Auto-fills record context, prompts requiring user input show a small form. HTML responses rendered with formatting.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Assistant IA' / 'AI Assistant').

property.name: namedCredential
property.label: Named Credential
property.description: Named Credential routing the Apex callout to the org's REST API. Default 'Agentforce_API'. Despite the legacy name, it's used for any /services/data/... callout — Prompt Templates, Agent API, etc. Setup → Named Credentials in your org.

property.name: promptsJson
property.label: Prompts catalogue (JSON)
property.description: JSON array. Each entry: { apiName, label, icon, objects:['Account',...], recordInputName:'Input:Account', userInputs:[{name,label,type,required,options}] }. 'objects' filters by host record type — empty list = always show. Leave the prop empty to use the default catalogue (Account/Contact/Deal/Lead/Case summaries + free-text Summarize/Refine).

property.name: autoRunFirstPrompt
property.label: Auto-run first prompt on load
property.description: When ON, the first applicable prompt runs automatically as soon as the page loads. Skips silently if any required user input is empty.

property.name: maxHeight
property.label: Maximum component height (px)
property.description: 0 (default) = no cap, the component grows with the AI response. Set a number (e.g. 600) to cap the vertical footprint and enable scroll inside the component when the response is very long.
